response.sql:
WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS album_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(album_rate) AS rate
  FROM album_stats
  WHERE album_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(a.album_rate) AS average_rate,
  AVG(CAST(a.track_count AS REAL)) AS average_track_count,
  AVG(a.album_rate - m.rate) AS average_amount_above_mean
FROM album_stats AS a
CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m
WHERE a.album_rate > m.rate;

assumptions.assumption: A track’s rate is Bytes divided by Milliseconds, and an album’s rate is the average of its tracks’ rates with either size value missing excluded. The mean is an unweighted mean across groups that have a rate; tracks with no AlbumId form one group.
